name: frog-squat.html
instructions:
1. Grab a dumbbell with both hands and rest it in front of you, between your legs.
2. Position your feet wider than shoulder-width, with toes pointing outward at a 45-degree angle.
3. Brace your core and maintain a straight back. This is the starting position.
4. Lower your hips towards the ground as far as possible or at least until your thighs are parallel with the floor by bending your knees, and keeping your chest up.
5. Push through your heels to return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top. This is one rep.
6. Repeat for desired reps.
